Hero description: Software for industry and business — from PLC programs and high-level macros to modern web and desktop applications.
About us description: We are software developers with experience in industrial and ambition to move automation on upper level. We create technological solutions that help you use your full potential.
About us point3: We connect IT with industrial technology
About us illustration alt: Illustration of a team working on automation
Our goals description1: Our software is fast in use. It does as much as possible and our primary goal is optimization.
Our goals description2: We want our software to be easy to use. We make our applications ergonomic, because we know how important it is for the work to be light and pleasant.
Our goals description3: We don't like restrictions. We want our software to be as powerful as possible. We prepare a place for development so that new goals can be achieved.
Services description: We are creating software for industry and individual clients, websites, window applications. We program PLC and we create high-level macros for them. On the end, we connect everything together to form integrated master systems.
ServiceIndustrialDesc: Dedicated applications for production and industrial clients.
ServicePlcDesc: PLC logic for automation systems, written with quality and standards in mind.
ServiceDesktopDesc: Reliable Windows tools that support daily engineering work.
ServiceWebDesc: Fast, responsive and easy to maintain web solutions.
ServiceMacroDesc: Macros that speed up PLC development and reduce repetitive work.
ServiceIntegrationDesc: We connect every layer into one consistent, manageable system.
Cta description: Tell us what you need and we will propose a solution.
Products description: Tools we build and use every day to deliver PLC software faster and more reliably.
Product1 Description: Ready-to-use online generator for PLC code in the VASS6 standard. Exports a ZIP package ready for TIA Project Importer — and can be adapted to your process.
Product1 Description1: Speeds up the PLC writing process.
Product1 Description2: Better and more convenient form of programming.
Product1 Description3: Reduction of PLC program writing costs.
Product1 Description4: Improving the quality of logic within the standard.
Product1 Description5: Avoids the often and tedious process of copying and pasting and the associated errors.
Product1 Description6: Improving the quality of the PLC program.
Product1 Description7: Facilitating the management of the program languages (generating web titles and other texts in standardized forms).
Product1 Description8: Better management of know-how for a specific technology within the standard.
Product1 Description9: Facilitation of the programming process (reduction of required offline competencies).
Product2 Description: Static library written in .NET standard. Enables generating of the PLC program (LAD) in C# language.
Product2 Description1: Full support for TIA Portal Openness.
Product2 Description2: Set of tools for helping you with creating own generation rules.
Product2 Description3: Separate library for define/import production line structure.
Product2 Description4: Support for convert Tia Library from project to C# class format.
Custom description: VASS6 PLC Creator is our ready-to-use generator for PLC software in TIA Portal, built for the VASS6 standard. When your process needs something different, we can adapt it — or build a dedicated generator from scratch.
Custom card1 description: We tailor VASS6 PLC Creator to your naming conventions, templates and project structure. If the generated result is not exactly what you need, we refine the rules together with you. Need a generator for another PLC standard? We can design and build it with you.
Custom card1 bullet1: Custom rules, templates and project structure
Custom card1 bullet2: Support for other standards and client-specific workflows
Custom card1 bullet3: Built on PLC TIA .NET Library and TIA Portal Openness

Downloads description: Programs and online tools that support the VASS6 workflow — from input data to a TIA project ready to import.
Download VASS6 description: Generate VASS6 PLC code in your browser. Upload your input data, configure the project and download a ZIP package ready to import.
Download VASS6 bullet1: Works in the browser — no installation
Download VASS6 bullet3: ZIP output ready for TIA Project Importer
Download importer description: Imports the ZIP generated by VASS6 PLC Creator into TIA Portal and creates the project structure automatically.
Download importer bullet2: Builds the TIA Portal project structure
Download importer note: The installer will be available here soon.
Downloads workflow title: From input data to TIA Portal in four steps
Download step1 description: Provide the source data for your VASS6 project.
Download step2 description: Select the options and structure for the generated code.
Download step3 description: VASS6 PLC Creator builds the PLC code.
Download step4 description: Download the package and import it with TIA Project Importer.
Download workflow note: The generated ZIP is imported into TIA Portal with TIA Project Importer.
